skill.name: canvas-design
skill.description: Create original static visual artwork, posters, and design objects using a philosophy-first canvas workflow for PNG or PDF outputs.
skill.summary: Guide philosophy-first creation of polished static canvas artwork.
skill.author: DYAI2025

security_audit.summary: Static command-execution and reconnaissance findings were false positives caused by Markdown paths, design prose, and font license text. Bundled binary findings were manually reviewed as TrueType font assets, but the skill contains prompt-injection style prose and unrestricted font download guidance that need author remediation.

remediation.issue: The skill fabricates prior user feedback in SKILL.md.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the false user quote with a neutral instruction to perform a final quality pass when appropriate.

remediation.issue: The skill allows open-ended font downloads from unspecified sources.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict font acquisition to named trusted sources, or rely only on bundled fonts with recorded checksums.

remediation.issue: Bundled binary fonts lack explicit provenance in the marketplace report.
remediation.suggestion: Document upstream font sources, licenses, and hashes so future reviewers can verify binary assets quickly.

content.value_statement: Design-heavy requests often need a clear visual philosophy before production starts. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through philosophy, canvas composition, and final polish.
actual_capabilities: Creates a named visual philosophy before production.
Guides one-page PNG or PDF canvas composition.
Uses bundled font families for typography choices.
Emphasizes sparse text, spatial hierarchy, color, and form.
Adds a final refinement pass for cleaner composition.
limitations: Does not include executable rendering scripts.
May require separate tools to create final PNG or PDF files.
External font downloads should be restricted to trusted sources.
Best suited for static visual artifacts, not interactive designs.

use_cases.title: Poster Art Direction
use_cases.description: Develop a philosophy and canvas direction for a refined event poster.

use_cases.title: Campaign Visual Concept
use_cases.description: Create a distinctive static graphic direction for a launch or announcement.

use_cases.title: Abstract Theme Translation
use_cases.description: Turn a subtle concept into an art-forward PNG or PDF composition.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Poster
prompt_templates.prompt: Use canvas-design to create a one-page poster for [event]. Keep text minimal and produce a PNG.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a static poster

prompt_templates.title: Develop a Visual Philosophy
prompt_templates.prompt: Use canvas-design to create only the visual philosophy for [subject]. Include color, form, space, and hierarchy.

prompt_templates.title: Build a PDF Art Object
prompt_templates.prompt: Use canvas-design to create a single-page PDF for [theme]. Use sparse labels, structured composition, and bundled fonts.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Multi-Page Series
prompt_templates.prompt: Use canvas-design to create a three-page PDF series for [concept]. Make each page distinct but visually connected.

output_examples.input: Create a museum-style poster for a climate research talk.
output_examples.output: A named visual philosophy, followed by a restrained poster concept with sparse labels, structured marks, and a PNG deliverable.

output_examples.input: Design an abstract PDF cover for a poetry collection.
output_examples.output: A concise aesthetic manifesto and a single-page PDF direction using typography, negative space, and careful color restraint.

output_examples.input: Make a three-page visual series for a product launch.
output_examples.output: A connected PDF sequence where each page varies the same philosophy through shape, rhythm, hierarchy, and limited text.

best_practices: Provide audience, medium, size, and any required words before asking for the canvas.
Ask for a philosophy first when the visual direction is unclear.
Review margins, legibility, and font choices before accepting the final asset.
anti_patterns: Do not request replicas of living artists or copyrighted campaign styles.
Do not use long paragraphs when the artifact should be mostly visual.
Do not ask the skill to build interactive interfaces or animations.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates visual philosophies and static PNG or PDF artwork concepts.

faq.question: Does it copy artist styles?
faq.answer: No. It instructs the agent to create original designs and avoid copying existing artists.

faq.question: Can it make multi-page work?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes guidance for additional pages when the user requests them.

faq.question: Are fonts included?
faq.answer: Yes. It bundles multiple TrueType fonts and Open Font License texts.

faq.question: Does it run code?
faq.answer: No executable scripts are included. A separate rendering tool may still be needed to produce final files.

faq.question: What should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the subject, audience, desired format, required text, and any brand constraints.
